sex.Description: Sex, as recorded in the source

Levels.M->F: male to female, as recorded in the source

race.Description: Race, as coded in the source (W, A, B)

vessels_quality.Description: Quality rating of the vessel trees (+ signs), as given in the source

exclude_suggested.Description: Whether the source suggests not using this subject (incidental findings: 'probably should not use' or 'don't use')

notes.Description: Remarks from the source (NormalDatabase2.pdf): image availability and quality (e.g. 'No rage': no MPRAGE, 'no flash': no FLASH T1, 'moved', 'cut'), incidental findings and family relationships between subjects
